STABILITY STUDY REPORT
Moderna, Inc. | Drug Product — mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)

Study Number: STAB-7971-80
Product: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) Injectable Suspension
Strength: 0.2 mg/mL (100 mcg/0.5 mL dose)
Container Closure: Type I glass vial, rubber stopper, aluminum crimp seal
Study Type: Long-Term Stability (ICH Q1A R2)
Storage Conditions: -20°C ± 5°C (primary); 2-8°C (in-use)
Study Initiation Date: 08 December 2024
Report Date: 16 October 2026
Prepared By: Andrew Dawson, Principal Scientist
1. Purpose
This report summarizes the stability data generated for Moderna, Inc.'s mRNA-1273 drug product stored under ICH Q1A(R2) long-term conditions (-20°C). The study supports the approved shelf life of 9 months at -20°C and 30 days at 2-8°C after thaw.

4. Conclusions
All tested parameters remained within specification throughout the study period. The data supports a shelf life of 9 months when stored at -20°C ± 5°C in the approved container closure system. An in-use stability period of 30 days at 2-8°C is supported following thaw. No significant trends or out-of-specification results were observed. Stability testing is ongoing at the 12-month timepoint.
